For the following weeks, they aimed to build consistency and observe effects on calm, focus, well-being, stress, anxiety, and relationships. Earlier that day, they also described meditating and practicing yoga poses on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

rollups.text: The user received an email from HR on 2023-03-10 saying they had been shortlisted for a Senior Marketing Manager position and called it a major milestone. They were interested in making a personal SWOT analysis and said they would try suggested tools and templates. No hiring outcome is recorded.

On 2023-05-23, the user introduced the art of imperfection as a framework and asked how to apply it in everyday life. They then requested an essay and a draft proposal, resulting in a framework titled The Art of Imperfection: A Framework for Acceptance and Inclusion, with goals involving self-acceptance, reducing perfectionism, celebrating uniqueness, supportive environments, and appreciating imperfection. The proposal suggested assessing progress through surveys, interviews, or other methods; no implementation or evaluation is recorded.

rollups.text: On 2023-05-23, the user said they had returned from a beach trip with more than 1,000 photos and felt overwhelmed. They preferred hierarchical folders with subfolders for days, activities, or locations and tags for specific details such as surfing and sunset. They did not want to keep every photo and planned to remove duplicates and near-duplicates, judge quality and significance, and make quick keep-or-delete decisions. They felt excited to start, but no completed sorting is recorded.

They planned to make spaghetti with black bean and tomato sauce, black bean and sweet potato tacos, and Apple Cinnamon Swirl Bread. They were interested in Plan to Eat because it combines meal planning, grocery lists, recipes, and leftovers, and said they were ready to start using it; actual setup or use was not confirmed. They also wanted to shop more efficiently because they often wandered aisles and forgot items.

They wanted easy, healthy meal ideas and were especially interested in a breakfast quesadilla and roasted vegetables; later they were excited to try roasting kale with butternut squash.
